spec: docs/WP12_SPECIFICATION.md section 4.7 (Resolution and Numerical Stability) and section 4.1 item 5 (TRIM and contact force not yet shown resolution-converged)
declared: 2026-10-31 (KST), WP-12 Phase 4. Written before any formal row of this study ran; only rows labelled DEV (artifacts/wp12/resolution_001, development and feasibility) ran before. Committed by the orchestrator before the formal matrix. A change after the commit is a new protocol version; failed or unstable rows are kept and reported, never rescored or silently rerun.
frozen_and_unchanged: tlmpm_v5.py, cutting law 8 and every law-4/5/8 parameter (they are defined in units of the grid dx and the spacing inside the solver and are used as the solver computes them; nothing is overridden)
tlmpm.py, tlmpm_v2.py, final_v4, every v1-v4 and goal threshold, the WP-11 records, the surface_protocol_v1 thresholds
blade_master_flat_board_v1 (the board geometry is reproduced as one TLMPM fixture box plus the table plane; nothing in the workcell record changes)

baseline.note: the formal WP-11/WP-12 resolution; every comparison is against it

runner.physics: scripts/run_wp12_resolution.py (one row per process; runner_sha256 and protocol_sha256 recorded in every result.json; refuses undeclared row ids except --dev)
runner.queue: scripts/run_wp12_resolution_queue.py (rows in the declared order, at most 2 concurrent on cuda:1, never overwrites)
runner.summary: scripts/summarize_wp12_resolution.py (read-only: evidence JSON, convergence verdicts, figures)

scope: Kinematic ideal tracking of the knife (no robot, IK, PhysX or cameras). Provisional, uncalibrated material. Forces are model diagnostics, not calibrated loads. One deterministic setup per row; no claim beyond the declared cases.

setup.solver: tlmpm_v5, cutting_law 8, slots_per_node 8 (rule for overflow below), cut_events_v1 recorder on (read-only; Hermite log for cut_aware_surface_v1)
setup.tool: ruler_knife_v2_y: 120 mm edge (half width 60 mm), 40 mm blade depth, 1.5 mm thick, double bevel 25 deg; TLMPM cross-section polygon from tool_profile; handle box as the blunt obstacle
setup.support: blade_master_flat_board_v1 geometry: one solid board box, top at workpiece-local z = 0, 360 x 190 x 20 mm centred under the workpiece; table plane at z = -20 mm; no riser, no slot
setup.control: 20 ms control steps, poses interpolated into 0.02/dt substeps by coupled_robot.interpolate_measured_poses (constant twist per control step), one CUDA graph per control step

cases.CUT: bar 72 x 24 x 18 mm on the board; vertical through-cut at x = 0 (blade normal +x, advance -z); 0.5 s settle with the edge parked 12 mm above the top; disarmed approach to 8 mm above the top at 20 mm/s; ARMED descent at 10 mm/s to the edge stop h above the board top (h = 0 = Option A of WP12_WORKCELL section 5); 0.3 s disarmed hold; disarmed 20 mm/s withdrawal; 0.5 s settle
cases.OBL20: same bar; blade plane through (0, 0, 9 mm) with normal (cos 20, 0, -sin 20) and advance (-sin 20, 0, -cos 20); armed from 8 mm before the section top along the advance until the edge reaches z = h = 0 (a solid board allows no overtravel); hold, withdrawal along -advance, settle as CUT
cases.TRIM: base 72 x 30 x 18 mm with a centred ellipsoidal dome (radius 12 mm, height 8 mm) above the plane z = 18 mm, sampled on the same lattice; rake 10 deg (advance (cos 10, 0, -sin 10), blade normal (sin 10, 0, cos 10)); 0.5 s settle with the edge 4 mm above its start; ARMED +x skim at 25 mm/s from x = -30 to +30 mm with the edge at z = 18.2 mm (variant gap_s: 18 + 0.2 s); 0.4 s disarmed hold at the end (blade stays)
cases.MULTI2: CUT bar, two sequential vertical through-cuts at x = -12 mm (digit 0) then x = +12 mm (digit 1), each as CUT with h = 0, a 20 mm/s disarmed move between them; 3 pieces of 24 mm. Reduced form of Test B (2 slices instead of 4)

setup.geometry_rule: Every workpiece dimension is a multiple of 6 mm, so all spacings 2 / 1.5 / 1 / 0.75 / 0.5 mm tile the same box exactly and the CUT/MULTI2 planes lie between two particle columns at every spacing. The dome is the set of lattice cells inside the analytic cap (its lattice volume is reported against the analytic 2413 mm^3).

controlled_variables.fixed_in_metres: material, tool geometry, board, workpiece box and dome, blade path, speeds, durations, the contact window, the near-cut column and every metric region; the blade path is never re-tuned per resolution
changes_with_resolution_by_construction: the particle lattice (lowest layer centre at s/2 above the board, lowest dome layer at 18 + s/2 mm), contact radius 0.45 s, particle volume s^3
law-4/5/8 lengths defined by the solver in units of dx (band 6 dx, rear and persistence 2 dx, lead 2 dx, core dx) and the cutting-zone half thickness s

confounds_reported.TRIM_edge_gap: with the edge at a fixed 18.2 mm the gap to the lowest dome layer is s/2 - 0.2 mm (0.8 / 0.55 / 0.3 / 0.175 / 0.05 mm, i.e. 0.40 / 0.37 / 0.30 / 0.23 / 0.10 s). Family F4 (gap_s) keeps it at 0.3 s to separate this lattice-phase effect from refinement. The blade bevel (0.15 mm below the edge for rho 10 deg) stays in metres in both.
confounds_reported.CUT_bottom_gap: with h = 0 the edge-to-bottom-layer gap is s/2, already fixed in units of s; family F5 compares h = +0.375 mm (metres) with h = +0.375 s

grid_rules.g4s: dx = 4 s (formal ratio; particle-per-cell edge ratio 4)
grid_rules.g4mm: dx = 4 mm fixed with s = 1 / 0.75 / 0.5 mm (ratio 4 / 5.33 / 8): tests the ratio

resolution_axes.dt_divides_control_step: 100 / 200 / 400 / 800 substeps per 20 ms (0.15 ms is not used: 133.3 substeps, the WP-11 F3 ERROR)

stability_limit.grid_cfl: dt * c_p / dx with c_p = sqrt((lambda + 2 mu) / rho)
stability_limit.adr0005_nominal: grid CFL <= 0.2 (the repository's dt selection rule, ADR 0005)
stability_limit.study_limit: grid CFL <= 0.5: rows above it are not run except the one declared probe F7; rows with 0.2 < CFL <= 0.5 are run and labelled within_study_limit_0.5 (s 1.5 / dt 0.2: 0.22; s 1 / dt 0.2: 0.33; s 0.75 / dt 0.2: 0.45; s 0.75 / dt 0.1: 0.22; s 0.5 / dt 0.1: 0.33)
stability_limit.excluded: s 0.5 mm, dx 2 mm, dt 0.2 ms (grid CFL 0.67): only as F7_stability_probe
stability_limit.other_rates: blade travel per substep <= 25 mm/s * 0.2 ms = 5 um << s; penalty contacts remove a fixed fraction (0.1 blade/board, 0.05 particle pair) of the predicted overlap per substep (bounded per step, no stiffness CFL)
stability_limit.empirical_check_per_row: finite x, v, det F at every control step, min det F > 0, max particle speed < 5 m/s (WP-10 screen); a row failing it is UNSTABLE, reported, excluded from fits

families.F1_main: 4 cases x spacing {2, 1.5, 1, 0.75, 0.5} mm x dt {0.2, 0.1, 0.05} ms, dx = 4 s, without s 0.5 / dt 0.2 (56 rows)
families.F2_dt_extension: 4 cases at s 1 mm, dx 4 mm, dt 0.025 ms (4 rows)
families.F3_fixed_grid: 4 cases at dx 4 mm, dt 0.1 ms, s {0.75, 0.5} mm; s 1 mm is the F1 formal row (8 rows)
families.F4_trim_gap_fixed_in_s: TRIM gap_s at dt 0.05 ms, s {2, 1.5, 0.75, 0.5}; at s 1 mm it equals the F1 row (4 rows)
families.F6_repeat: one repeat of each case at (1 mm, 0.1 ms) and (1 mm, 0.05 ms): noise band (8 rows)
families.F7_stability_probe: CUT, s 0.5 mm, dx 2 mm, dt 0.2 ms (grid CFL 0.67), never in a fit (1 row)
families.F8_timing: 4 cases x spacing {2, 1.5, 1, 0.75, 0.5} mm at dt 0.1 ms, dx = 4 s: the first 60 control steps (settle, approach, start of the armed cut), no surface, run with no other row of this study on the GPU (20 rows); runtime scaling is read from these, the full rows' timings are reported as measured under sharing

seeds.note: the setup has no random sampling (lattice workpieces, scripted path); seed 42 is recorded. Run-to-run differences come from GPU float atomics and are measured by F6.

metrics.separation_and_pieces: final mechanical components (cut_topology.mechanical_components_packed, the solver's own stencil graph) and mass fractions; CUT/OBL20: 2 parts each >= 0.40 and together >= 0.99; MULTI2: 3 parts each >= 0.25 and together >= 0.99 (separation_criterion, reporting rule of this study, not a frozen threshold)
metrics.remaining_bridges: direct code-0 bridges per cut digit (cut_diagnostics.direct_bridges: digit-0 particles whose valid stencil nodes host digit 1 and digit 2) at the end of each armed cut and at the end; severed line fraction per cut digit (primary coverage metric): reference lattice lines along the axis closest to the plane normal that straddle the declared plane, severed if any of their links with reference midpoint within 4 mm of the plane carries conflicting digits (all layers, and the bottom layer 0 for CUT/OBL20/MULTI2; TRIM: vertical lines through the plane z = 18 mm); the exact-plane link coverage (links straddling the declared reference plane that conflict; all, layer 0, layer 1) and unassigned particles within 3 mm are reported as secondary. Reason for the band (found in DEV): the second MULTI2 cut meets material displaced about 1 mm by the first cut, so its conflicting links lie one column off the declared reference plane
metrics.removal_fraction: TRIM: dome (z_ref > 18 mm) mass not in the substrate component / dome mass; substrate retained = base mass in the substrate component / base mass; the WP-11 trim criterion (removal >= 0.9 and substrate >= 0.99) is reported read-only; lowest dome layer attached count
metrics.contact_force: tool reaction (tlmpm reaction impulse over a control step / 20 ms, blade plus handle) in the PREDECLARED window from the planned edge pose: CUT/OBL20/MULTI2 armed steps with the edge z in [h, 18 mm]; TRIM armed steps with the edge x in [-12, +12] mm. Reported: mean |F|, peak |F| (max of 20 ms means, not a substep peak), mean resistance along the advance, and the steady sub-window mean (edge z in [4.5, 13.5] mm; TRIM x in [-6, 6] mm)
metrics.deformation_near_cut: P95 over particles with |reference distance to a declared plane| <= 3 mm of |u| and of |u - mean u of its mechanical component| (piece translation removed; primary), at the end of each armed cut and at the end. TRIM: substrate particles with z_ref in [15, 18) mm under the dome footprint: P95 / median / max of the depression -u_z and P95 |u - piece translation|
metrics.min_det_F: minimum det F over all particles at every control-step end (20 ms sampling) over the whole row, and at the end
metrics.board_penetration: max over the row of the material-fixture contact-sphere overlap (tlmpm stats[0], radius - SDF), count of particle centres below the board top (z < 0), min particle z; blade overlap (stats[3]) reported; the planned edge never goes below z = h >= 0
metrics.surface_fidelity: final state: surface_metrics_v1 cut-face distance P95 in current space (to the side locus plane, surface_report) and in reference space (Phase 3 reference_space reading), for particle_surface_v1 (A = CuttingSurface current_volume_v1, voxel s/2; its reference space is the approximate pull-back) and cut_aware_surface_v1 (B, cut_events_v1 Hermite log, total-F embedding; exact pre-embedding vertices); reported in metres and in spacings; the Phase 1/3 drivers are reused read-only with their spacing globals set to the row's spacing. Labelled per extractor. Not a Phase 3 gate.
metrics.runtime: ms per substep (median of the per-control-step CUDA-graph launch + device wait / substeps, recorder on, host analysis excluded); loop and total wall; GNU time wall and max RSS of the process; full rows run up to 2 at a time on a GPU shared with another agent (the queue records the concurrent rows and an nvidia-smi snapshot at start), so the F8 exclusive rows are the timing reference
metrics.memory: solver device bytes (TLMPM.memory_bytes), recorder device bytes, Warp mempool high-water bytes after the physics and after the surface extraction
metrics.counts: particles, grid nodes, grid dims, edge segments, substeps per control step, grid CFL, cut events and slot diagnostics

paths.P_s_primary: spacing at dt 0.05 ms, dx = 4 s: s 2 / 1.5 / 1 / 0.75 / 0.5 mm (all grid CFL <= 0.17, within ADR 0005)
paths.P_s_formal_dt: spacing at dt 0.1 ms, dx = 4 s (s 0.75 and 0.5 exceed CFL 0.2, within 0.5; labelled)
paths.P_dt: dt at fixed spacing (dx = 4 s): s 1 mm: 0.2 / 0.1 / 0.05 / 0.025 ms; other spacings: 0.2 / 0.1 / 0.05 ms where admissible
paths.P_ratio: s 1 / 0.75 / 0.5 mm at dx 4 mm, dt 0.1 ms (particle refinement at fixed grid)
paths.confound_rows: F4 and F5 are compared with their F1 counterparts; they are characterization, not convergence paths

convergence.expected_order: first order in s (lattice-staircase geometry, contact radius 0.45 s, linear grid basis, lattice phase of the lowest layer) and first order in dt (symplectic Euler, per-substep penalty contact). Accepted observed range 0.5 <= p <= 3.
convergence.noise_band: nu = max(nu0, 2 * max |repeat - original| over the two F6 points) per case and metric, applied at every resolution (assumption: nondeterminism does not grow strongly with resolution)
continuous_rule: uses the three finest valid points h1 > h2 > h3 of a path (valid = COMPLETED and stable); fewer than 3 -> INCONCLUSIVE
if every pairwise difference among the three is <= max(nu, tol * |Q3|) (tol_abs for absolute metrics) -> CONVERGED (insensitive within tolerance; order not identifiable)
observed order p solves (Q2 - Q1)/(Q3 - Q2) = (h1^p - h2^p)/(h2^p - h3^p) (bisection, p in [0.05, 8]); undefined when the differences change sign (oscillation)
Richardson estimate Q* = Q3 - (Q2 - Q3) h3^p / (h2^p - h3^p); GCI_fine = 1.25 |Q3 - Q2| / ((h2/h3)^p - 1), relative to |Q3| for relative metrics
CONVERGED if 0.5 <= p <= 3 and GCI_fine <= tol
INCONCLUSIVE if |Q3 - Q2| <= nu while the coarser difference is not, or p > 3
NOT_CONVERGED otherwise: oscillation above the noise band, p < 0.5, or p in range with GCI_fine > tol
least-squares fit Q = Q* + C h^p over all valid points of the path is reported as secondary
convergence.zero_limit_metrics: surface P95 in metres, board/blade overlap: CONVERGED iff monotone decreasing over the three finest with 0.5 <= p <= 3 (log-log slope); values all below a declared floor (1e-6 m) count as CONVERGED (at floor); otherwise NOT_CONVERGED (INCONCLUSIVE if within the noise band)
convergence.discrete_metrics: component count, separation_criterion, TRIM criterion, bridges == 0, centres below board == 0: CONVERGED iff identical at the three finest valid points; NOT_CONVERGED if the two finest differ; INCONCLUSIVE otherwise
convergence.verdict_per_metric: per case and path; the headline verdict per metric is CONVERGED only if P_s_primary and P_dt at s = 1 mm are both CONVERGED, NOT_CONVERGED if either is NOT_CONVERGED, else INCONCLUSIVE. A row that merely completes proves nothing about convergence.
convergence.runtime_memory: not convergence metrics: power-law fit of ms/substep and memory against particle count

execution.device: cuda:1 (shared with another agent): at most 2 of this study's processes at once; never stop other processes
execution.order: rows in the order listed (repeats and the formal resolution first, coarse before fine, 0.5 mm and the probe last, F8 timing rows at the end one at a time)
execution.outputs: artifacts/wp12/resolution_002/<row_id>/ (manifest.json, result.json, state.npz, steps.npz), logs artifacts/wp12/logs/resolution_002_<row_id>.log with GNU time; a queue log artifacts/wp12/resolution_002/queue.jsonl

failure_rules.ERROR: kept and reported with the exception; not rerun
failure_rules.slot_overflow: SlotOverflowError -> one rerun of that row with slots_per_node 16 under the row id + '_slots16' (declared here); both kept
failure_rules.out_of_memory: NOT_RUN (memory) with the error; no smaller substitute
failure_rules.unstable: UNSTABLE (non-finite state or failed stability screen): a finding, excluded from fits
failure_rules.surface_error: the surface metric of that row is ERROR; the physics row stands
failure_rules.budget: rows not started when the budget is spent are NOT_RUN (budget)

execution.compute_budget: estimated 5-6 GPU-hours of summed row wall time (measured DEV under 2-way sharing: 1 mm CUT 0.56 ms/substep and 35 s; 1 mm MULTI2 165 s; 0.5 mm CUT 9.3 ms/substep and 473 s at dt 0.1 ms with 248,832 particles), about 3 h of queue wall with 2 concurrent rows; hard cap 9 GPU-hours of summed row wall time and 6 hours of queue wall time; disk <= 5 GB under artifacts/wp12/resolution_002
